name: causal decoder keeps earlier logits fixed
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(4)
model = TinyCausalLM(19, 8, 6).eval()
x = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4]])
y = x.clone(); y[0, 3] = 9
a = model(x); b = model(y)
assert a.shape == (1, 4, 19) and torch.isfinite(a).all()
assert torch.allclose(a[:, :3], b[:, :3], atol=1e-5)

name: classifier ignores invalid token content
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(5)
lm = TinyCausalLM(23, 8, 6).eval()
classifier = SequenceClassifier(lm, 3).eval()
x = torch.tensor([[2, 5, 7, 11]])
changed = x.clone(); changed[0, 3] = 17
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, True, False]])
assert classifier(x, mask).shape == (1, 3)
assert torch.allclose(classifier(x, mask), classifier(changed, mask), atol=1e-5)

name: incremental and full greedy routes agree
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(8)
model = TinyCausalLM(13, 8, 7).eval()
prompt = torch.tensor([[1, 2]])
a = greedy_generate(model, prompt, 3, use_cache=False)
b = greedy_generate(model, prompt, 3, use_cache=True)
assert a.shape == (1, 5)
assert torch.equal(a, b)
assert torch.equal(a[:, :2], prompt)
